full_judgment: 6. The substantive case of the Opposite Party No. 26 that is, the defendant No. 13, is that there is no cause of action for the suit which was barred by limitation as well as for defect of parties and also barred by estoppel, waiver and acquiescence. There was no proper representation of the so-called Deity and Gopal Das Baishnab had no right to represent the Deity. Plot No. 459 really corresponds to item No. 11 of schedule 1(one) of the plaint. The 1st and 2nd schedule land never belonged to the plaintiff Deity which were the personal self acquired property of Kulak Das Namasudra and late Sikandar Ali during the life time of Kulak Das Namasudra purchased the property mentioned in schedule 3(three) of the plaint in money execution case No. 12 of 1950 of the Second Court of Sadar Munsif, Sylhet and on 10-1-51 he obtained a sale certificate in respect or his purchase through court and on 29-2-51 delivery of possession through court was made to him and he having remained in possession peaceably and adversely for well over 12 years sold an area of 10.5 and odd bighas of land by a registered deed dated 3-4-67 out of schedule 3(three) to the defendant Nos. 13 and 14 and defendant No.14 on 31-3-80 sold his share to the defendant No.13 and, as such, the suit can not be maintained.
